{{Quote|And there's a Sakiyan sneaking through the woods straight ahead.|The Wistie captive|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>}}
One of several [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]] held as a [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder's]] [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] in that [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Imperial Station Bravo|palace]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], '''a Wistie''' helped the [[Ghostling]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Arawynne]] attempt to escape the garden when the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] sent a team to recapture the escaped Ghostling [[Youngling/Legends|children]]. The Wistie [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] ahead and informed Arawynne of the whereabouts of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]]. The intelligence helped Arawynne lure the Sakiyan into a pit trap created by the Ghostlings.
